findings.title: Blocked-email lookup is case-sensitive
findings.body: This query compares the submitted address exactly with the stored address. User signup assigns the submitted email without normalizing it, so an address such as `BLOCK@SPAMMERS.ORG` can bypass a block entry stored as `block@spammers.org`. Normalize addresses consistently or make the lookup case-insensitive so casing cannot evade the block.

findings.title: Concurrent matches can lose counter increments
findings.body: The method reads `match_count`, increments the in-memory value, and saves it. If two signup validations match the same blocked address concurrently, both can read the same count and write the same incremented value, losing one match. Use an atomic database increment so the match statistics remain accurate under concurrent attempts.
